sources.title: Cape Verde basic safety data
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan
sources.officialityEvidence: Japan's live Foreign Ministry traveller page is destination-specific, updated 13 March 2026 and describes the visitor visa route applicable to Japanese travellers.
sources.supportingExcerpt: 短期滞在査証は到着空港においても取得可能ですが、事前に取得しておくことをおすすめします。

sources.title: Republic of the Congo basic safety data
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan
sources.officialityEvidence: Japan's live Foreign Ministry traveller page is destination-specific, updated 18 May 2026 and requires travelers to obtain the visa beforehand through the Congolese Embassy or another mission.
sources.supportingExcerpt: 渡航目的にかかわらず、あらかじめ駐日コンゴ共和国大使館等で査証を取得する必要があります。

sources.title: Liberia basic safety data
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan
sources.officialityEvidence: Japan's live Foreign Ministry traveller page, last updated 21 May 2025, expressly requires advance acquisition through Liberia's mission in Japan or another country.
sources.supportingExcerpt: 入国査証（ビザ）の事前取得が必要です。必ず駐日リベリア共和国大使館若しくは第三国にあるリベリア大使館で目的に応じた査証をあらかじめ取得してください。

sources.title: Niger basic safety data
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan
sources.officialityEvidence: Japan's live Foreign Ministry traveller page, last updated 4 August 2025, identifies the pre-travel Niger embassy route and the available single- and multiple-entry visa types.
sources.supportingExcerpt: 査証は在中国ニジェール共和国大使館または在仏ニジェール共和国大使館等で、一次または数次の査証を取得することができます。

sources.title: Sierra Leone basic safety data
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan
sources.officialityEvidence: Japan's live Foreign Ministry traveller page, last updated 21 May 2025, expressly states that the Sierra Leone arrival visa is available at Freetown's Lungi International Airport.
sources.supportingExcerpt: フリータウンのルンギ国際空港でVisa on arrivalの取得も可能です。

policies.title: Japanese ordinary passports: Cape Verde short-stay visa on arrival
policies.summary: Japan's current destination-specific guidance says a short-stay visa can be obtained at Cape Verde's arrival airports.
conditions: The guidance recommends applying through EASE at least five days before travel but expressly preserves airport issuance for the short-stay visa.
The named ports, entry purpose, passport, health, fee, carrier and final-admission requirements remain applicable.

policies.title: Japanese ordinary passports: Republic of the Congo advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Japan's current destination-specific guidance requires travelers to obtain the Republic of the Congo visa beforehand from an embassy or other mission.
conditions: The visa must be obtained before travel through the Republic of the Congo Embassy in Japan or another competent mission.
Purpose, passport, health, document, carrier and final-admission requirements remain applicable.

policies.title: Japanese ordinary passports: Liberia advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Japan's current destination-specific guidance requires acquiring the Liberian entry visa before travel through an embassy.
conditions: The visa must be obtained in advance from Liberia's Embassy in Japan or a Liberian embassy in another country.
Purpose, passport, health, document, carrier and final-admission requirements remain applicable.
The live source was last updated 21 May 2025; recheck this pair earlier than the standard refresh interval.

policies.title: Japanese ordinary passports: Niger advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Japan's current destination-specific guidance says a required Niger visa is acquired from its embassies in China, France or another competent mission.
conditions: The guidance identifies advance embassy-issued single-entry and multiple-entry visas; it does not describe border issuance.
Travel-warning, purpose, passport, health, document, carrier and final-admission requirements remain applicable.
The live source was last updated 4 August 2025; recheck this pair earlier than the standard refresh interval.

policies.title: Japanese ordinary passports: Sierra Leone visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Japan's current destination-specific guidance expressly makes a visa on arrival available at Freetown's Lungi International Airport.
conditions: An advance mission route is also available, but the ordinary short-visitor arrival-issued route is the least restrictive supported status.
The named airport, passport, yellow-fever, fee, purpose, carrier and final-admission requirements remain applicable.
The live source was last updated 21 May 2025; recheck this pair earlier than the standard refresh interval.
